name: Bug report / Relatar erro
about: Help reproduce a problem using synthetic data only.
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

**Before posting / Antes de enviar**
Never include API keys, gateway tokens, .env, private prompts, customer data or unredacted screenshots/logs. Security issues: see SECURITY.md.

**Version and environment / Versão e ambiente**
Router version or commit, Node version, OS, provider, endpoint and client version. Do not include credentials.

**Steps to reproduce / Como reproduzir**
Use synthetic inputs. Describe what you did, what happened, and what you expected.

**Request outcome / Resultado do pedido**
Status code and redacted error code. Was there an uncertain result? Do not retry a paid request just to complete this report.

**Minimal reproduction / Exemplo mínimo**
A minimal request with placeholders and synthetic data, including relevant feature headers and whether streaming/cache/idempotency was used.
